I'm excited to share with you the content we have lined up for this month. We'll be taking a close look at twelve cars that are set to go up for sale at the spring auction, which is always one of the highlights of the season. Additionally, we've included a comprehensive guide to restoring chrome that's sure to be a valuable resource for anyone looking to get into the hobby. And as always, we're also featuring letters from our readers. You can access all of this content online right now if you'd like, or if you're not interested, you can simply head to the bottom of the page and click the unsubscribe button. 

Best,
John
